spec.description: Ametalin Cavity Drainage Battens are an innovative triple-layer, high-density polypropylene, self-adhesive passive open air-flow strip specifically designed to isolate and create ventilation, cavity drainage, and thermal separation behind roof and wall cladding[][]. Installed between pliable building membranes and exterior cladding or roofing sheets, they provide a firm base to install to while creating a natural drainage plane for moisture to escape[][]. In metal roof assemblies, they help locate and maintain the dew point at the underside of the roof cladding to prevent condensation from forming on the pliable membrane[].
features: Assists in thermal mitigation strategies and energy efficiency[
Creates a natural drainage plane for moisture to escape[
Engineered for very high compression resistance[
Withstands normal foot traffic and provides high screw-pull resistance[
10 mm thickness allows doubling up to create 20mm cavities per NCC 2022[

technical.value: Triple-layer high density polypropylene (PP core with 2 layers of premium PP facing)
High-tack self-adhesive backing with peel-off release liner

range.size_or_rating: 45 mm x 1200 mm x 10 mm (50 pieces)

spec.fire: Heat, fire, and UV resistant; compliant for non-combustible constructions under NCC provisions where drainage cavities are specified[][][
spec.compliance: NCC 2022 Vol 1 F8D5 and J4D3, NCC Housing Provisions 10.8.3 and 13.2.2; AS 4200.2:2017[][
spec.sustainability: 100% recyclable polypropylene construction, inert, non-toxic, rot-proof
install: Install pliable building membrane to roof or wall frame construction in accordance with AS 4200.2:2017 [2.4.1]
Locate structural framing member (stud, plate, rafter, or purlin) to which battens will be applied[
Ensure surfaces to be adhered to are clean, dry, and free from dirt, grease, oil, and contaminants[
Peel back release liner from self-adhesive backing strip[
Centre the batten parallel along the supporting framing member and press firmly into place[
For a 20mm cavity or higher ventilation requirements, apply a second batten directly over the first[
Fasten cladding or roofing through the battens directly into structural framing
Install battens concurrently with outer cladding or roofing to ensure optimal durability[
selection_checklist: Confirm required cavity depth (10mm single layer or 20mm double layer) [2.4.2]
Verify framing centres and calculate total lineal metres (each piece is 1.2m)[
Ensure structural framing surfaces are clean and free of moisture or chemical residues[
Confirm cladding fixing screw length accounts for the 10mm or 20mm batten buildup
Verify application matches NCC 2022 condensation management requirements (F8D5 / 10.8.3)[
accessories: Cladding fasteners with appropriate extended length
limitations: Non-structural cavity spacer; claddings and roofing must fix directly into structural framework [2.4.2]
Surfaces must be clean and dry; moisture reduces initial adhesive bond[][
Must be stored flat in a clean, dry place out of direct sunlight[
Should not be left permanently exposed to UV without outer cladding or roofing
spec.warranty: Covered by Ametalin standard product warranty[

problem_keywords: lack of ventilation in cavity wall
thermal bridging between frame and cladding
use_cases: creating a 10mm or 20mm ventilated drainage cavity behind lightweight fibre-cement or timber wall cladding
isolating metal roof cladding from pliable membrane to prevent underside condensation pooling
providing a continuous passive airflow pathway under metal roofing in temperate and cold climate zones
satisfying NCC 2022 condensation management requirements for drained external cavities
not_for: internal direct plasterboard furring without framing
retrieval.rag_summary: Ametalin Cavity Drainage Battens (CDB-451200) are 45 mm x 1200 mm x 10 mm self-adhesive, open-air-flow strips manufactured from a high-density triple-layer polypropylene core. Engineered for application over pliable membranes on steel and timber wall framing and metal roofs, they establish a durable ventilation and drainage plane (RT 0.15 in-situ) that directs trapped moisture away from building fabrics. Highly compression-resistant and stackable to 20mm to meet NCC 2022 condensation management and energy efficiency provisions, they prevent interstitial moisture damage, mould growth, and roof condensation.
